description: QA-00 reviewed allowlist of known contract deviations on main. Each entry matches exactly one (validator, entity, model, field, mismatch[, value]) found by a validator. 'kind' classifies it: breaking-mismatch (will fail at runtime), contract-stale (code is ahead of canonical.json), loose-typing (weaker type than the contract). Validators fail on any unlisted deviation, any entry that no longer matches, and any entry with a missing/unknown kind or validator or an empty reason/task/owner. Remove an entry in the same PR that fixes it.
